items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: some guys around there that he knew, like Piney Brown and all those guys

ctx.x: Well, he wasn't sort of like --

I don't know how he inherited the band but I think he was just a very popular guy, you know. And some guys around there that he knew, like Piney Brown and all those guys, they gave him the name of "Count", you know.
You know, knowing over the years -- well, since I've known him, anyway, it seems strange that he would have taken over a band, you know.
